# Inventory export

**Status:** claimed
**Blocked by:** none
**Type:** discussion

## Questions

Should CSV output include a name,quantity header row, or contain data rows only? This is the last unsettled design question.

## Accepted answers

export_rows(items) accepts a list of records with name strings and nonnegative integer quantity values. It returns CSV text with name and quantity fields in input order. Use the standard csv module for quoting, a comma separator, and LF line endings. Inputs are already validated. Empty input raises ValueError("Inventory is empty.") without returning CSV text. There is no file writing or interface work.

## Evidence

The existing inventory records names and quantities. All supported inputs and output rules are agreed except the presence of a header row.
docs/planning/export/map.md:
# Inventory export

## Destination

Define export_rows(items), returning CSV text for inventory records.

## Decisions so far

- [CSV content](design.md): name and quantity fields, input order, standard CSV quoting, LF line endings.
- [Empty input](design.md): raise ValueError("Inventory is empty.") without returning CSV text.

## Not yet specified

- [Header row](design.md#questions): include column headings or return data rows only. Unblocked.

## Out of scope

File writing, an interface, and input validation.
